resourceUsage.title: Resource usage
resourceUsage.cpuHint: CPU used by the current Bakabase service process, relative to all available logical processors. Excludes child processes such as FFmpeg.
resourceUsage.memoryHint: Physical memory used by the current Bakabase service process.
resourceUsage.directoryHint: Total file size in the data directory, refreshed every 5 minutes. Includes databases, covers and caches; symbolic links are excluded.
resourceUsage.calculating: Calculating directory size in the background…
resourceUsage.directoryPartial: Some files could not be read; showing the measured total.
resourceUsage.directoryUnavailable: Directory size could not be refreshed; any displayed value is from the last measurement.
resourceUsage.hide.label: Hide resource usage
resourceUsage.hidden.title: Resource usage hidden
resourceUsage.hidden.description: To show it again, go to System → Configuration → Functional configurations and turn on “Show resource usage”.
